instruction: Tulis skrip semak sijil TLS banyak hos
output:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
for h in api.example.com shop.example.com; do
  exp=$(openssl s_client -connect "$h:443" -servername "$h" </dev/null 2>/dev/null \
    | openssl x509 -noout -enddate | cut -d= -f2)
  echo "$h tamat: $exp"
done
```
`-servername` SNI wajib untuk vhost moden. Banding tarikh dengan `date -d` untuk amaran <30 hari dalam monitoring.

instruction: Tulis backup sulit dengan GPG dalam bash
output:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
F="/backup/$(date +%F).tgz"
tar czf - /data | gpg --encrypt -r ops@contoh.my -o "$F.gpg"
find /backup -name '*.gpg' -mtime +30 -delete
```
Sulitkan strim (tiada fail jelas di cakera), penerima `--encrypt -r`, putar 30 hari. Kunci peribadi luar hos — sulit tanpa dekripsi berasingan tidak berguna.

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
tmux new-session -d -s dev -n edit
tmux send-keys -t dev:edit 'cd ~/proj && vim' Enter
tmux new-window -t dev -n run 'npm run dev'
tmux split-window -t dev:run -h 'tail -F app.log'
tmux attach -t dev
```
Sesi berkod: editor + runner + log berdampingan setiap pagi dengan satu arahan. `send-keys` memandu panel secara skrip.

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
U=${1:?username required}
useradd -m -s /bin/bash -G sudo "$U"
mkdir -p /home/"$U"/.ssh
cp /root/.ssh/authorized_keys /home/"$U"/.ssh/
chown -R "$U:$U" /home/"$U"/.ssh
chmod 700 /home/"$U"/.ssh
passwd -l "$U"
echo "$U sedia (kunci sahaja)"
```
Kunci-bukan-kata-laluan (`passwd -l`), keizinan ssh ketat (700/600). Semak `lastlog` untuk akaun basi suku tahunan.

instruction: Tulis pasangan systemd timer ganti cron
output:
```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/sync.service
[Unit]
Description=Sync data
[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/opt/sync.sh

# /etc/systemd/system/sync.timer
[Unit]
Description=Sync harian
[Timer]
OnCalendar=daily
Persistent=true
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
```
`systemctl enable --now sync.timer`. Kelebihan lawan cron: log jurnal, `Persistent` kejar ketinggalan, `list-timers` audit semua jadual satu pandangan.

instruction: Tulis ujian bats untuk skrip bash
How do I pick a deploy target interactively with fzf?
output:
```bash
target=$(printf '%s\n' prod staging dev | fzf --prompt='Deploy ke: ')
[[ -n "$target" ]] || exit 0
./deploy.sh "$target"
```
Empty selection aborts safely. fzf replaces fragile numbered `select` menus with fuzzy search over dynamic lists (branches, hosts, files).

instruction: Tulis lanjutan LVM selamat dalam bash
output:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
vgs vg0 | tail -1
lvextend -r -L +10G vg0/data
df -h /data
```
Semak ruang bebas (`vgs`) dahulu, `-r` saiz semula filesystem sebaris (ext4/xfs) tanpa downtime. Tanpa `-r`, filesystem lama tidak nampak ruang baharu — kesilapan klasik.

instruction: Tulis imbas kesihatan ssh banyak hos
output:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
for h in $(cat hosts.txt); do
  out=$(ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 "$h" 'uptime; systemctl --failed --no-legend' 2>&1) &&
    echo "== $h OK" || echo "== $h GAGAL: $out"
done | tee sweep.log
```
`BatchMode` tiada prompt (kunci sahaja), `tee` papar + simpan bukti. `systemctl --failed` dedah unit rosak setiap hos.

```
/var/log/app/*.log {
  daily
  rotate 14
  compress
  delaycompress
  missingok
  notifempty
  create 0640 app adm
  postrotate
    systemctl reload app >/dev/null
  endscript
}
```
`delaycompress` biarkan log semalam boleh grep, `postrotate` buka semula FD log app. Tanpa ini cakera penuh senyap dalam minggu.

instruction: Tulis skrip uji beban ringan dengan curl dan time
output:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
URL=${1:?url required}
for i in $(seq 1 20); do
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "$i %{http_code} %{time_total}s\n" "$URL"
done | awk '$2 != 200'
```
Cetak hanya bukan-200 — keluaran kosong bermakna 20/20 lulus. `-w` beri kod+masa setiap hit; awk tapis kegagalan. Untuk beban sebenar guna `ab`/k6.

instruction: How do I debug a running process file access with strace?
output:
```bash
strace -f -e trace=%file -p 1234 -o /tmp/trace.log &
 sleep 10; kill $!
grep ENOENT /tmp/trace.log | head
```
Attach to confusion: every open/stat with errors surfaces missing configs and permission lies. `-c` summarizes syscall time when hunting slowness instead.

instruction: Tulis menu dialog bash untuk operasi pelayan
Tulis sandaran sqlite dengan pengesahan integriti
output:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
F="/backup/db-$(date +%F).sqlite"
sqlite3 app.db ".backup '$F'"
sqlite3 "$F" 'PRAGMA integrity_check;' | grep -q '^ok$' || { echo ROSAK; exit 1; }
sha256sum "$F" > "$F.sha"
echo "backup $F sah"
```
`.backup` selamat selagi DB hidup (bukan `cp` mentah). Sahkan `integrity_check` + cap sha — sandaran tidak disahkan bukan sandaran.

instruction: How do I convert CSV to JSON with jq in bash?
output:
```bash
jq -Rn '[inputs | split(",") | {nama: .[0], harga: .[1]}] | map(select(.harga != "harga"))' inventori.csv
```
`-R` raw input, `-n` no auto-read, `inputs` streams lines — CSV to JSON array without Python. Skip the header with select, split on delimiter.

instruction: Tulis skrip semak pautan mati dokumentasi
output:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
grep -rhoE 'https?://[^)" ]+' docs/ | sort -u | while IFS= read -r u; do
  curl -sf -o /dev/null --max-time 10 "$u" || echo "MATI: $u"
done
```
Kumpul URL unik dahulu (elak hit berganda), semak selari terhad bila banyak. Dokumentasi reput tanpa semakan berkala.

instruction: Tulis skrip keras servis baru (checklist automatik)
output:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
SVC=${1:?service required}
systemctl is-enabled "$SVC" || echo "WARN: tidak enable"
ss -tlnp | grep -q "$SVC" || echo "WARN: tiada port dengar"
test -f "/etc/$SVC.conf" || echo "WARN: tiada config"
journalctl -u "$SVC" -p err --since today --no-pager | head -5
```
Empat semakan piawai setiap servis baharu: kekal boot, dengar port, config wujud, tiada ralat hari ini. Amaran bukan gagal — manusia putuskan.

instruction: Tulis nota keluaran automatik dari git dalam bash
output:
```bash
prev=${1:?tag lama}; cur=${2:-HEAD}
echo "## Perubahan $prev..$cur"
git log --oneline "$prev..$cur"
echo "## Fail berubah"
git diff --stat "$prev..$cur" | tail -3
```
Nota keluaran dari sejarah sebenar (bukan ingatan). Tag setiap keluaran supaya julat sentiasa bermakna.
